------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m1p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes, Players, MaxSlot, MinNode, MaxNode
ASSUME MaxSlot \in Nat

VARIABLES token, holds, grants, capacity
\* token: node currently holding the ring token
\* holds: TRUE iff the token holder is inside its allocation (critical) section
\* grants: [1..MaxSlot -> SUBSET Players]  players currently occupying each slot
\* capacity: highest slot index currently open; changes at runtime
vars == <<token, holds, grants, capacity>>

Slots == 1..MaxSlot

RingSucc(n) == IF n = MaxNode THEN MinNode ELSE n + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Nodes
  /\ holds \in BOOLEAN
  /\ grants \in [Slots -> SUBSET Players]
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxSlot

Init ==
  /\ token = MinNode
  /\ holds = FALSE
  /\ grants = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
  /\ capacity = MaxSlot

\* Token holder enters its critical section
Enter ==
  /\ ~holds
  /\ holds' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, grants, capacity>>

\* Allocate an open, empty slot to a player (only while holding the token)
Allocate ==
  /\ holds
  /\ \E s \in Slots, p \in Players :
        /\ s <= capacity
        /\ grants[s] = {}
        /\ grants' = [grants EXCEPT ![s] = {p}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity, holds>>

\* Release a slot back to the free pool
Release ==
  /\ holds
  /\ \E s \in Slots :
        /\ grants[s] # {}
        /\ grants' = [grants EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity, holds>>

\* Leave the critical section and pass the token onward around the ring
Pass ==
  /\ holds
  /\ holds' = FALSE
  /\ token' = RingSucc(token)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, capacity>>

\* Runtime capacity change; the operator never closes a slot that is occupied
Reconfigure ==
  /\ ~holds
  /\ \E c \in 0..MaxSlot :
        /\ \A s \in Slots : (grants[s] # {}) => (s <= c)
        /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, holds, grants>>

Next == Enter \/ Allocate \/ Release \/ Pass \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No slot is ever occupied by two different players at once.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A s \in Slots : \A p, q \in grants[s] : p = q

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {1, 2, 3}
  Players = {pa, pb}
  MaxSlot = 3
  MinNode = 1
  MaxNode = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker runs its allocators as a ring of nodes that pass a single token around; only the node currently holding the token may enter its allocation section and hand out lobby slots, which gives mutual exclusion over the shared slot table. Each slot can be handed to a player only if it is currently empty and its index falls within the lobby's live capacity. The capacity is reconfigured at runtime as the operator grows or shrinks the lobby, but a shrink is only permitted when it would not close a slot that is still occupied. Nodes may also release a slot back to the free pool while holding the token, and a holder leaves its section by passing the token to the next node on the ring. SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot is ever occupied by two different players at the same time.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m4p1t1 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS MaxId, QCap
ASSUME MaxId \in Nat /\ QCap \in Nat

VARIABLES inbox, processing, record, accepted
\* inbox: set of accepted-but-unapplied update ids (order-free, so reorderable)
\* processing: ids a worker has dequeued but not yet committed
\* record: ids merged into the shared lock-state record, awaiting device ack
\* accepted: every live update id the network admitted past backpressure
vars == <<inbox, processing, record, accepted>>

Ids == 1..MaxId

TypeOK ==
  /\ inbox \subseteq Ids
  /\ processing \subseteq Ids
  /\ record \subseteq Ids
  /\ accepted \subseteq Ids

Init ==
  /\ inbox = {}
  /\ processing = {}
  /\ record = {}
  /\ accepted = {}

\* A device submits an update; backpressure blocks admission when the inbox is full
Submit ==
  /\ Cardinality(inbox) < QCap
  /\ \E id \in Ids \ accepted :
        /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {id}
        /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<processing, record>>

\* A worker dequeues any pending update (any order -> reordering is allowed)
Dequeue ==
  /\ \E id \in inbox :
        /\ inbox' = inbox \ {id}
        /\ processing' = processing \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, accepted>>

\* Commit merges the in-flight update into the shared record without overwriting prior ones
Commit ==
  /\ \E id \in processing :
        /\ processing' = processing \ {id}
        /\ record' = record \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, accepted>>

\* A commit may fail transiently; the update returns to the inbox for retry, never dropped
Fail ==
  /\ \E id \in processing :
        /\ processing' = processing \ {id}
        /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, accepted>>

\* The device acknowledges a durable update; it leaves the pipeline and the live set together
Ack ==
  /\ \E id \in record :
        /\ record' = record \ {id}
        /\ accepted' = accepted \ {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, processing>>

Next == Submit \/ Dequeue \/ Commit \/ Fail \/ Ack

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every admitted update is always still present somewhere in the pipeline or record: none is lost.
NoLostUpdate ==
  \A id \in accepted : id \in inbox \/ id \in processing \/ id \in record

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  MaxId = 4
  QCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl: A smart-home door-lock network admits lock and unlock updates through a bounded work queue with backpressure: when the inbox is full, new submissions are refused rather than dropped. Admitted updates sit in an order-free inbox, so a worker may dequeue and apply them in any order (messages can be reordered). Applying an update is two-phase: the worker first dequeues it into an in-flight processing set, then commits it by merging it into the shared lock-state record without overwriting earlier updates. A commit may fail transiently, in which case the in-flight update is returned to the inbox to be retried later and is never discarded. Finally, once a device acknowledges a durable update, that update leaves both the record and the live admitted set together. SAFETY PROPERTY: every update the network admitted past backpressure is always still present somewhere in the pipeline or in the shared record, so no update is ever lost.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m7p4t3 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Trains, Cap
ASSUME Cap \in Nat

VARIABLES counter, inRegion, snap, loc
\* counter: shared CAS register holding current occupancy of the bounded track region
\* inRegion: set of trains physically inside the region
\* snap: [Trains -> Nat \cup {-1}] each train last read of counter, or "none"
\* loc: [Trains -> {"out","reading","in"}] control location of each train
vars == <<counter, inRegion, snap, loc>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ counter \in 0..Cap
  /\ inRegion \subseteq Trains
  /\ snap \in [Trains -> (0..Cap) \cup {"none"}]
  /\ loc \in [Trains -> {"out","reading","in"}]

Init ==
  /\ counter = 0
  /\ inRegion = {}
  /\ snap = [t \in Trains |-> "none"]
  /\ loc = [t \in Trains |-> "out"]

\* A train reads the occupancy register, snapshotting the expected value (it may then be slow)
Read(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "out"
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = counter]
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "reading"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<counter, inRegion>>

\* Compare-and-swap succeeds only if the register is unchanged since the read and below capacity
CasEnter(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "reading"
  /\ snap[t] = counter
  /\ counter < Cap
  /\ counter' = counter + 1
  /\ inRegion' = inRegion \cup {t}
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "in"]
  /\ UNCHANGED snap

\* If another train changed the register first, the CAS fails and the train retreats
CasFail(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "reading"
  /\ snap[t] # counter
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "out"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<counter, inRegion, snap>>

\* A train leaves the region and decrements the shared register
Leave(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "in"
  /\ counter' = counter - 1
  /\ inRegion' = inRegion \ {t}
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "out"]
  /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next == \E t \in Trains : Read(t) \/ CasEnter(t) \/ CasFail(t) \/ Leave(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The bounded track region never holds more trains than its capacity.
CapacityOK == Cardinality(inRegion) <= Cap

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Trains = {t1, t2, t3}
  Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl: A subway signalling system protects a shared track region that can safely hold only a bounded number of trains at once. Admission is lock-free: a shared compare-and-swap register records the region's current occupancy. A train first reads the register, snapshotting the value it expects; it may then be slow before acting, but it never fails outright. To enter it performs a compare-and-swap that succeeds only if the register still equals its snapshot and the occupancy is below capacity, atomically incrementing the register and moving into the region. If another train changed the register in the meantime the compare-and-swap fails and the train retreats to try again. When a train leaves the region it decrements the register. SAFETY PROPERTY: the bounded track region never holds more trains than its capacity.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od11m0p0t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Jobs, MaxV
ASSUME MaxV \in Nat

VARIABLES owner, version, loc, seen
\* owner: the job currently holding the printer, or "none"
\* version: printer lock version counter (wraps), read optimistically by jobs
\* loc: [Jobs -> {"idle","trying","printing"}] control state of each job
\* seen: [Jobs -> 0..MaxV] the lock version each trying job last observed
vars == <<owner, version, loc, seen>>

Bump(v) == IF v = MaxV THEN 0 ELSE v + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Jobs \cup {"none"}
  /\ version \in 0..MaxV
  /\ loc \in [Jobs -> {"idle","trying","printing"}]
  /\ seen \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxV]

Init ==
  /\ owner = "none"
  /\ version = 0
  /\ loc = [j \in Jobs |-> "idle"]
  /\ seen = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]

\* A job requests the printer, optimistically snapshotting the current lock version
Request(j) ==
  /\ loc[j] = "idle"
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![j] = version]
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![j] = "trying"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version>>

\* Acquire succeeds only if the version is unchanged since the snapshot and the printer is free
Acquire(j) ==
  /\ loc[j] = "trying"
  /\ seen[j] = version
  /\ owner = "none"
  /\ owner' = j
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![j] = "printing"]
  /\ UNCHANGED seen

\* A version mismatch means another job intervened; re-read and retry
Retry(j) ==
  /\ loc[j] = "trying"
  /\ seen[j] # version
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![j] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, loc>>

\* The holder finishes printing and releases the printer, bumping the version
Finish(j) ==
  /\ loc[j] = "printing"
  /\ owner = j
  /\ owner' = "none"
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED seen

Next == \E j \in Jobs : Request(j) \/ Acquire(j) \/ Retry(j) \/ Finish(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A job may be printing only if it actually holds the printer lock: mutual exclusion.
MutexOK == \A j \in Jobs : loc[j] = "printing" => owner = j

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Jobs = {j1, j2, j3}
  MaxV = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexOK
nl: A print-shop job spooler serializes access to a single printer, the critical resource, using optimistic locking with retry. The printer carries a version counter that jobs read without holding any lock. A job requests the printer by snapshotting the current version and moving to a trying state; requests from different jobs may be serviced in any order (messages can be reordered). A job acquires the printer only if the version is still equal to its snapshot and the printer is currently free, at which point it becomes the owner, bumps the version, and starts printing. If the version has changed since the snapshot, another job intervened, so the job re-reads the version and retries. When the owner finishes printing it releases the printer and bumps the version again. SAFETY PROPERTY: a job is printing only when it actually holds the printer lock, so at most one job ever prints at a time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m9p4t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines, MaxCap, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, cap, stock, synced, admin
\* epoch: current network configuration epoch
\* cap: per-machine stock capacity for the current epoch (reconfigurable)
\* stock: [Machines -> 0..MaxCap] units currently loaded in each machine
\* synced: [Machines -> BOOLEAN] whether a machine has adopted the current epoch
\* admin: TRUE when the privileged admin override is unlocked
vars == <<epoch, cap, stock, synced, admin>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ stock \in [Machines -> 0..MaxCap]
  /\ synced \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ cap = MaxCap
  /\ stock = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ synced = [m \in Machines |-> TRUE]
  /\ admin = FALSE

\* Reconfigure the network to a new epoch with a new per-machine cap; existing stock must fit
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ \E c \in 0..MaxCap :
        /\ \A m \in Machines : stock[m] <= c
        /\ cap' = c
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ synced' = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, admin>>

\* A machine adopts the current epoch before it may serve normal operations
Sync(m) ==
  /\ ~synced[m]
  /\ synced' = [synced EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, stock, admin>>

\* A synced machine dispenses one unit
Dispense(m) ==
  /\ synced[m]
  /\ stock[m] > 0
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = stock[m] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, synced, admin>>

\* A synced machine is restocked by one unit, never past the current cap
Restock(m) ==
  /\ synced[m]
  /\ stock[m] < cap
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = stock[m] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, synced, admin>>

\* The privileged admin override sets any machine's stock directly, bypassing epoch sync but not the cap
AdminSet(m) ==
  /\ admin
  /\ \E v \in 0..cap :
        stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, synced, admin>>

\* Toggle the admin override lock
AdminToggle ==
  /\ admin' = ~admin
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, stock, synced>>

Next == Reconfigure \/ AdminToggle
        \/ (\E m \in Machines : Sync(m) \/ Dispense(m) \/ Restock(m) \/ AdminSet(m))

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No machine ever holds more units than the current epoch's capacity allows.
CapacityOK == \A m \in Machines : stock[m] <= cap

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Machines = {m1, m2}
  MaxCap = 3
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl: A network of vending machines is reconfigured by epoch: a central controller bumps the epoch and installs a new per-machine stock capacity, and it will only shrink the capacity to a value that all current stock levels already fit within. When the epoch advances, every machine is marked unsynced and must adopt the new epoch before it may serve normal operations. A synced machine dispenses one unit at a time and may be restocked one unit at a time, but never past the current capacity. Separately, a privileged admin override can be unlocked; while unlocked it sets any machine's stock directly, bypassing the epoch-sync requirement, but it still respects the current capacity. The override lock can be toggled on or off. SAFETY PROPERTY: no machine ever holds more units than the current epoch's capacity allows.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od8m8p5t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Students, Seats

VARIABLES coarse, fine, committed, loc
\* coarse: the single department (coarse) lock holder, or "none"
\* fine: [Students -> Seats \cup {"none"}] the seat (fine) lock each student holds
\* committed: [Seats -> Students \cup {"none"}] irreversible enrollment, written once per seat
\* loc: [Students -> {"idle","coarse","fine"}] where each student is in the lock hierarchy
vars == <<coarse, fine, committed, loc>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in Students \cup {"none"}
  /\ fine \in [Students -> Seats \cup {"none"}]
  /\ committed \in [Seats -> Students \cup {"none"}]
  /\ loc \in [Students -> {"idle","coarse","fine"}]

Init ==
  /\ coarse = "none"
  /\ fine = [s \in Students |-> "none"]
  /\ committed = [seat \in Seats |-> "none"]
  /\ loc = [s \in Students |-> "idle"]

\* Acquire the coarse department lock first (hierarchy: coarse before fine)
AcquireCoarse(s) ==
  /\ loc[s] = "idle"
  /\ coarse = "none"
  /\ coarse' = s
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![s] = "coarse"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, committed>>

\* Acquire a fine seat lock, only while holding coarse, only on an uncommitted, unlocked seat
AcquireFine(s, seat) ==
  /\ loc[s] = "coarse"
  /\ coarse = s
  /\ committed[seat] = "none"
  /\ \A s2 \in Students : fine[s2] # seat
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = seat]
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![s] = "fine"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, committed>>

\* Commit the enrollment: the irreversible seat grant, then release both locks
Commit(s) ==
  /\ loc[s] = "fine"
  /\ LET seat == fine[s] IN
        /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![seat] = s]
        /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
  /\ coarse' = "none"
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]

\* A slow student may back off and release its held locks without committing, then retry later
Release(s) ==
  /\ loc[s] \in {"coarse", "fine"}
  /\ coarse' = IF coarse = s THEN "none" ELSE coarse
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED committed

Next == \E s \in Students :
           \/ AcquireCoarse(s)
           \/ (\E seat \in Seats : AcquireFine(s, seat))
           \/ Commit(s)
           \/ Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A student can hold a seat's fine lock only if that seat is not already irreversibly
\* committed to a different student -- this is what makes the enrollment happen at most once.
CommitOnce ==
  \A s \in Students, seat \in Seats :
     (fine[s] = seat /\ committed[seat] # "none") => committed[seat] = s

=============================================================================
nl: A university course-registration system uses hierarchical locking: to enroll, a student must first take a coarse department-wide lock and only then a fine per-seat lock. A student acquires the coarse lock when it is free, and may take a fine seat lock only while holding the coarse lock, only on a seat that no other student currently locks and that has not already been irreversibly committed. Committing an enrollment is the irreversible action: it records the student as the seat's permanent owner and releases both locks. Students may be slow -- lingering while holding locks -- but never fail; a slow student may voluntarily back off, releasing its held locks without committing, and retry later. SAFETY PROPERTY: a student can hold a seat's fine lock only when that seat has not already been committed to a different student, so an enrollment for any seat happens at most once.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od6m5p1t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Controllers, Proposals, Quorum, MaxCrash
ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ MaxCrash \in Nat

VARIABLES proposed, votes, committed, record, crashed
\* proposed: dispatch proposals currently open for voting
\* votes: [Proposals -> SUBSET Controllers] controllers that have voted for each proposal
\* committed: proposals that reached quorum and were declared committed
\* record: proposals actually written into the shared dispatch record
\* crashed: controllers that have silently crashed (at most MaxCrash of them)
vars == <<proposed, votes, committed, record, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ proposed \subseteq Proposals
  /\ votes \in [Proposals -> SUBSET Controllers]
  /\ committed \subseteq Proposals
  /\ record \subseteq Proposals
  /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
  /\ proposed = {}
  /\ votes = [p \in Proposals |-> {}]
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ record = {}
  /\ crashed = {}

\* Open a new dispatch proposal for voting
Propose(p) ==
  /\ p \notin proposed
  /\ proposed' = proposed \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, committed, record, crashed>>

\* A live (non-crashed) controller casts its vote for an open proposal
Vote(c, p) ==
  /\ p \in proposed
  /\ c \notin crashed
  /\ c \notin votes[p]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = votes[p] \cup {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, committed, record, crashed>>

\* A proposal that has a quorum of votes is committed and written to the shared record together
Commit(p) ==
  /\ p \in proposed
  /\ p \notin committed
  /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) >= Quorum
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {p}
  /\ record' = record \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, votes, crashed>>

\* A controller may crash silently; the bank tolerates at most MaxCrash such failures
Crash(c) ==
  /\ c \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < MaxCrash
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, votes, committed, record>>

\* A proposal may be retired and later re-opened for a fresh round of voting
Retire(p) ==
  /\ p \in proposed
  /\ proposed' = proposed \ {p}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, record, crashed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Proposals : Propose(p) \/ Commit(p) \/ Retire(p)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, p \in Proposals : Vote(c, p)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every committed dispatch update is durably present in the shared record: none is lost.
NoLostUpdate == committed \subseteq record

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
  Proposals = {p1, p2}
  Quorum = 2
  MaxCrash = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper is coordinated by a set of controllers that must agree on each dispatch decision by quorum voting. A dispatch proposal is opened for voting, and each live controller may cast a single vote for it. A proposal that has collected a quorum of votes is committed and, in the same step, written durably into the shared dispatch record. The bank tolerates silent crashes: at most one controller may crash without warning, after which it casts no further votes, but the remaining controllers can still form a quorum. A proposal may also be retired and later re-opened for a fresh round of voting; committing is irreversible. SAFETY PROPERTY: every dispatch update that has been committed is always durably present in the shared record, so no committed update is ever lost.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od8m6p4t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Seats, Clients, Instances, MaxTTL, PoolCap
ASSUME MaxTTL \in Nat /\ PoolCap \in Nat

VARIABLES held, grantedBy, ttl, avail
\* held: [Seats -> SUBSET Clients] the client(s) currently leasing each seat
\* grantedBy: [Seats -> Instances \cup {"none"}] which server instance granted the lease
\* ttl: [Seats -> 0..MaxTTL] remaining lease time before expiry
\* avail: shared pool of free capacity units, drawn down by either instance
vars == <<held, grantedBy, ttl, avail>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ held \in [Seats -> SUBSET Clients]
  /\ grantedBy \in [Seats -> Instances \cup {"none"}]
  /\ ttl \in [Seats -> 0..MaxTTL]
  /\ avail \in 0..PoolCap

Init ==
  /\ held = [s \in Seats |-> {}]
  /\ grantedBy = [s \in Seats |-> "none"]
  /\ ttl = [s \in Seats |-> 0]
  /\ avail = PoolCap

\* Either instance grants a lease on a free seat to a client, drawing one unit from the shared pool
Grant(i, s, c) ==
  /\ held[s] = {}
  /\ avail > 0
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![s] = {c}]
  /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![s] = i]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = MaxTTL]
  /\ avail' = avail - 1

\* The granting instance renews an active lease, resetting its time-to-live
Renew(i, s) ==
  /\ grantedBy[s] = i
  /\ ttl[s] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = MaxTTL]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, grantedBy, avail>>

\* Time passes; an active lease ticks down toward expiry
Tick(s) ==
  /\ grantedBy[s] # "none"
  /\ ttl[s] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = ttl[s] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, grantedBy, avail>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the seat and returning its unit to the shared pool
Expire(s) ==
  /\ grantedBy[s] # "none"
  /\ ttl[s] = 0
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
  /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
  /\ avail' = avail + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED ttl

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Seats, c \in Clients : Grant(i, s, c)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Seats : Renew(i, s)
  \/ \E s \in Seats : Tick(s) \/ Expire(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No seat is ever leased to two different clients at once, even though two independent
\* instances draw leases from the same shared pool.
NoOverLease == \A s \in Seats : \A x, y \in held[s] : x = y

=============================================================================
nl: A university course-registration system runs two independent server instances that hand out seat reservations from one shared pool of capacity units. Ownership is lease-based with expiry: either instance may grant a lease on a currently free seat to a client, drawing one unit from the shared pool and starting a time-to-live countdown. The granting instance may renew an active lease to reset its time-to-live. As time passes an active lease ticks down, and once it reaches zero the lease expires and is reclaimed, freeing the seat and returning its capacity unit to the shared pool. SAFETY PROPERTY: no seat is ever leased to two different clients at the same time, even though both instances draw from the same pool.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m9p0t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, Instances, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, owner, robotEpoch, loc
\* epoch: current fleet configuration epoch
\* owner: the robot currently holding the critical charging bay, or "none"
\* robotEpoch: [Robots -> 0..MaxEpoch] the epoch each robot has synced to
\* loc: [Robots -> {"idle","using"}] whether a robot is using the critical resource
vars == <<epoch, owner, robotEpoch, loc>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ owner \in Robots \cup {"none"}
  /\ robotEpoch \in [Robots -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ loc \in [Robots -> {"idle","using"}]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ owner = "none"
  /\ robotEpoch = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ loc = [r \in Robots |-> "idle"]

\* Reconfigure the fleet to a new epoch; any current holder must first have released
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ owner = "none"
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, robotEpoch, loc>>

\* A robot syncs to the current epoch before it may be granted the resource
Sync(r) ==
  /\ robotEpoch[r] # epoch
  /\ robotEpoch' = [robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, loc>>

\* Either scheduler instance grants the free resource to a synced robot
Acquire(i, r) ==
  /\ owner = "none"
  /\ loc[r] = "idle"
  /\ robotEpoch[r] = epoch
  /\ owner' = r
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![r] = "using"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, robotEpoch>>

\* The holder releases the critical resource
Release(r) ==
  /\ owner = r
  /\ owner' = "none"
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, robotEpoch>>

Next ==
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r) \/ Release(r)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Robots : Acquire(i, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A robot uses the critical charging bay only while it is the recorded owner:
\* mutual exclusion holds even though two scheduler instances share the grant pool.
MutexOK == \A r \in Robots : loc[r] = "using" => owner = r

=============================================================================

  Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
  Instances = {i1, i2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexOK

The fleet is reconfigured by epoch number: the epoch may advance only when the bay is currently free, and each robot must sync to the current epoch before it can be granted the resource. Either scheduler instance may grant the free bay to a synced robot, recording it as the owner and putting it into the using state. The holder later releases the bay, returning it to the free pool. SAFETY PROPERTY: a robot is in the using state only while it is the single recorded owner of the bay, so at most one robot ever uses the critical charging bay at a time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od0m8p5t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Surgeons, Rooms, Suites

VARIABLES suiteLock, roomLock, operated, phase
\* suiteLock: [Suites -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}] the coarse per-suite lock holder
\* roomLock: [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}] the fine per-room lock holder
\* operated: [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}] the irreversible operation record (write once)
\* phase: [Surgeons -> {"scrubbed","hasSuite","hasRoom"}] progress through the lock hierarchy
vars == <<suiteLock, roomLock, operated, phase>>

SuiteOf(o) == CHOOSE u \in Suites : TRUE

TypeOK ==
  /\ suiteLock \in [Suites -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}]
  /\ roomLock \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}]
  /\ operated \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}]
  /\ phase \in [Surgeons -> {"scrubbed","hasSuite","hasRoom"}]

Init ==
  /\ suiteLock = [u \in Suites |-> "free"]
  /\ roomLock = [o \in Rooms |-> "free"]
  /\ operated = [o \in Rooms |-> "free"]
  /\ phase = [g \in Surgeons |-> "scrubbed"]

\* Take the coarse suite lock first
ClaimSuite(g, u) ==
  /\ phase[g] = "scrubbed"
  /\ suiteLock[u] = "free"
  /\ suiteLock' = [suiteLock EXCEPT ![u] = g]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "hasSuite"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<roomLock, operated>>

\* Take a fine room lock, only while holding its suite, only on a not-yet-operated free room
ClaimRoom(g, o) ==
  /\ phase[g] = "hasSuite"
  /\ suiteLock[SuiteOf(o)] = g
  /\ roomLock[o] = "free"
  /\ operated[o] = "free"
  /\ roomLock' = [roomLock EXCEPT ![o] = g]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "hasRoom"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<suiteLock, operated>>

\* Perform the operation: the irreversible action, then release both locks
Operate(g, o) ==
  /\ phase[g] = "hasRoom"
  /\ roomLock[o] = g
  /\ operated' = [operated EXCEPT ![o] = g]
  /\ roomLock' = [roomLock EXCEPT ![o] = "free"]
  /\ suiteLock' = [suiteLock EXCEPT ![SuiteOf(o)] = "free"]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "scrubbed"]

\* A slow surgeon may pause and abort, releasing any locks it holds, then start over later
Abort(g) ==
  /\ phase[g] \in {"hasSuite","hasRoom"}
  /\ suiteLock' = [u \in Suites |-> IF suiteLock[u] = g THEN "free" ELSE suiteLock[u]]
  /\ roomLock' = [o \in Rooms |-> IF roomLock[o] = g THEN "free" ELSE roomLock[o]]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "scrubbed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED operated

Next ==
  \/ \E g \in Surgeons, u \in Suites : ClaimSuite(g, u)
  \/ \E g \in Surgeons, o \in Rooms : ClaimRoom(g, o) \/ Operate(g, o)
  \/ \E g \in Surgeons : Abort(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A surgeon can hold a room's fine lock only if that room has not already been operated on
\* by a different surgeon -- so the irreversible operation on any room happens at most once.
OperateOnce ==
  \A g \in Surgeons, o \in Rooms :
     (roomLock[o] = g /\ operated[o] # "free") => operated[o] = g

=============================================================================
nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler protects surgeries with hierarchical locks: a surgeon must first take the coarse lock on a surgical suite and only then a fine lock on a specific operating room within that suite. A surgeon takes a suite lock when it is free, and may take a room lock only while holding that room's suite lock, only on a room that is currently unlocked and has not already been operated on. Performing the operation is the irreversible action: it permanently records which surgeon operated on the room and then releases both the room and suite locks. A surgeon may be slow -- holding locks while it works -- but never fails; a slow surgeon may pause and abort, releasing whatever locks it holds, and start over later. SAFETY PROPERTY: a surgeon can hold a room's fine lock only when that room has not already been operated on by a different surgeon, so each room is operated on at most once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od6m9p5t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, Requests, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, accepted, reqEpoch, assign, served, carState
\* epoch: current dispatch-configuration epoch
\* accepted: requests that have been accepted into the system
\* reqEpoch: [Requests -> 0..MaxEpoch] epoch a request was accepted under
\* assign: [Cars -> Requests \cup {"none"}] the request a car is currently assigned
\* served: set of requests already irreversibly served (write-once membership)
\* carState: [Cars -> {"idle","busy"}] whether a car is currently moving
vars == <<epoch, accepted, reqEpoch, assign, served, carState>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ accepted \subseteq Requests
  /\ reqEpoch \in [Requests -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ assign \in [Cars -> Requests \cup {"none"}]
  /\ served \subseteq Requests
  /\ carState \in [Cars -> {"idle","busy"}]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ accepted = {}
  /\ reqEpoch = [r \in Requests |-> 0]
  /\ assign = [c \in Cars |-> "none"]
  /\ served = {}
  /\ carState = [c \in Cars |-> "idle"]

\* Reconfigure the dispatch controller to a new epoch; open requests must be re-accepted
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch = MaxEpoch THEN 0 ELSE epoch + 1
  /\ accepted' = {}
  /\ reqEpoch' = [r \in Requests |-> 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, served, carState>>

\* A hall request is accepted, stamped with the current epoch
Accept(r) ==
  /\ r \notin accepted
  /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {r}
  /\ reqEpoch' = [reqEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, assign, served, carState>>

\* Dispatch an idle car to a non-stale, not-yet-served request
Dispatch(c, r) ==
  /\ carState[c] = "idle"
  /\ assign[c] = "none"
  /\ r \in accepted
  /\ reqEpoch[r] = epoch
  /\ r \notin served
  /\ \A other \in Cars : assign[other] # r
  /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![c] = r]
  /\ carState' = [carState EXCEPT ![c] = "busy"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, accepted, reqEpoch, served>>

\* A (possibly slow) busy car completes its trip: the irreversible serve, then it goes idle
Serve(c) ==
  /\ carState[c] = "busy"
  /\ assign[c] # "none"
  /\ served' = served \cup {assign[c]}
  /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![c] = "none"]
  /\ carState' = [carState EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, accepted, reqEpoch>>

Next ==
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E r \in Requests : Accept(r)
  \/ \E c \in Cars, r \in Requests : Dispatch(c, r)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Serve(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A car may be assigned a request only if that request has not already been served:
\* the irreversible serve of any request happens at most once.
AssignSafe == \A c \in Cars : assign[c] # "none" => assign[c] \notin served

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cars = {c1, c2}
  Requests = {q1, q2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AssignSafe
nl: An elevator bank's dispatch controller is reconfigured by epoch number, wrapping through a bounded range; each reconfiguration clears the set of open (re-acceptable) requests, though already-served requests stay permanently served. Hall requests are accepted and stamped with the epoch current at acceptance. An idle car may be dispatched to a request only if that request is not stale -- its stamp matches the current epoch -- and it has not already been served. Dispatching assigns the request to the car and sets the car moving. Completing a trip is the irreversible action: a busy car, which may be slow but never fails, eventually records its request as permanently served and returns to idle. SAFETY PROPERTY: a car may be assigned a request only when that request has not already been served, so each request is irreversibly served at most once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m8p1t5 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Pharmacists, Bins, Dispenses

VARIABLES coarse, fine, committed, record, admin
\* coarse: holder of the coarse cabinet lock, or "none"
\* fine: [Bins -> Pharmacists \cup {"none"}] holder of each fine bin lock
\* committed: set of dispense ids the system has declared committed
\* record: set of dispense ids durably written into the shared dispense record
\* admin: TRUE while the privileged admin override is unlocked
vars == <<coarse, fine, committed, record, admin>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in Pharmacists \cup {"none"}
  /\ fine \in [Bins -> Pharmacists \cup {"none"}]
  /\ committed \subseteq Dispenses
  /\ record \subseteq Dispenses
  /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ coarse = "none"
  /\ fine = [b \in Bins |-> "none"]
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ record = {}
  /\ admin = FALSE

\* Acquire the coarse cabinet lock first
AcquireCoarse(p) ==
  /\ coarse = "none"
  /\ coarse' = p
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, committed, record, admin>>

\* Acquire a fine bin lock, only while holding the coarse lock
AcquireFine(p, b) ==
  /\ coarse = p
  /\ fine[b] = "none"
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = p]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, committed, record, admin>>

\* Commit a dispense while holding both locks: mark it committed AND write the shared record together
Commit(p, b, d) ==
  /\ coarse = p
  /\ fine[b] = p
  /\ d \notin committed
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {d}
  /\ record' = record \cup {d}
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
  /\ coarse' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED admin

\* The privileged admin override commits a dispense directly, bypassing the lock hierarchy,
\* but still writes the shared record in the same step
AdminCommit(d) ==
  /\ admin
  /\ d \notin committed
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {d}
  /\ record' = record \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, admin>>

\* Toggle the admin override lock
AdminToggle ==
  /\ admin' = ~admin
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, committed, record>>

Next ==
  \/ AdminToggle
  \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : AcquireCoarse(p)
  \/ \E p \in Pharmacists, b \in Bins : AcquireFine(p, b)
  \/ \E p \in Pharmacists, b \in Bins, d \in Dispenses : Commit(p, b, d)
  \/ \E d \in Dispenses : AdminCommit(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every committed dispense is durably present in the shared record: no update is ever lost.
NoLostUpdate == committed \subseteq record

=============================================================================
nl: A pharmacy prescription dispenser guards its inventory with hierarchical locks: a pharmacist must first take the coarse cabinet lock and only then a fine per-bin lock. Committing a dispense is done while holding both locks, and it marks the dispense committed while, in the same step, writing it durably into the shared dispense record and releasing both locks. There is also a privileged admin override: while unlocked, an administrator may commit a dispense directly, bypassing the lock hierarchy, but this path still writes the shared record in the same step. The admin override can be toggled on or off. SAFETY PROPERTY: every dispense that has been committed -- whether through the normal lock hierarchy or the admin override -- is always durably present in the shared record, so no update is ever lost.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od1m9p4t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Runways, MaxCap, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, cap, occ, synced
\* epoch: current airspace configuration epoch
\* cap: [Runways -> 0..MaxCap] per-runway occupancy capacity for the current epoch
\* occ: [Runways -> 0..MaxCap] number of aircraft currently on each runway
\* synced: [Runways -> BOOLEAN] whether a runway has adopted the current epoch
vars == <<epoch, cap, occ, synced>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ cap \in [Runways -> 0..MaxCap]
  /\ occ \in [Runways -> 0..MaxCap]
  /\ synced \in [Runways -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ cap = [r \in Runways |-> MaxCap]
  /\ occ = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
  /\ synced = [r \in Runways |-> TRUE]

\* Advance to a new epoch and re-cap one runway; capacity may only be set to fit current occupancy
Reconfigure(r) ==
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch = MaxEpoch THEN 0 ELSE epoch + 1
  /\ \E c \in 0..MaxCap :
        /\ occ[r] <= c
        /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![r] = c]
  /\ synced' = [synced EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED occ

\* A runway adopts the current epoch before it will accept or release aircraft
Sync(r) ==
  /\ ~synced[r]
  /\ synced' = [synced EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, occ>>

\* An aircraft (which may be slow in holding, but never fails) lands, if there is room
Land(r) ==
  /\ synced[r]
  /\ occ[r] < cap[r]
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![r] = occ[r] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, synced>>

\* An aircraft departs the runway
Depart(r) ==
  /\ synced[r]
  /\ occ[r] > 0
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![r] = occ[r] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, synced>>

Next == \E r \in Runways : Reconfigure(r) \/ Sync(r) \/ Land(r) \/ Depart(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No runway ever holds more aircraft than its current epoch capacity permits.
CapacityOK == \A r \in Runways : occ[r] <= cap[r]

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Runways = {rwA, rwB}
  MaxCap = 3
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl: An air-traffic runway allocator is reconfigured by epoch, wrapping through a bounded range of epochs: advancing the epoch re-caps one runway, and the new capacity may only be set to a value that the runway's current occupancy already fits within. When a runway is re-capped it is marked unsynced and must adopt the new epoch before it will accept or release aircraft again. A synced runway accepts a landing only when it has room below its current capacity, and releases a departing aircraft when it is non-empty. Aircraft may be slow -- lingering in a holding pattern -- but never fail. SAFETY PROPERTY: no runway ever holds more aircraft than its current epoch capacity permits.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m6p3t0 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Books, Patrons, MaxTTL, MaxCrash
ASSUME MaxTTL \in Nat /\ MaxCrash \in Nat

VARIABLES holder, claim, ttl, crashed
\* holder: [Books -> Patrons \cup {"none"}] the patron currently holding each book's lease
\* claim: [Patrons -> Books \cup {"none"}] the book each patron believes it holds
\* ttl: [Books -> 0..MaxTTL] remaining lease time before expiry
\* crashed: patrons that have silently crashed (at most MaxCrash of them)
vars == <<holder, claim, ttl, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in [Books -> Patrons \cup {"none"}]
  /\ claim \in [Patrons -> Books \cup {"none"}]
  /\ ttl \in [Books -> 0..MaxTTL]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Patrons

Init ==
  /\ holder = [b \in Books |-> "none"]
  /\ claim = [p \in Patrons |-> "none"]
  /\ ttl = [b \in Books |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = {}

\* A live patron reserves a free book, taking a lease and recording the reservation on both sides
Reserve(p, b) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ holder[b] = "none"
  /\ claim[p] = "none"
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![b] = p]
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![p] = b]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = MaxTTL]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* A live patron renews its lease, resetting the time-to-live
Renew(p, b) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ holder[b] = p
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = MaxTTL]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, claim, crashed>>

\* Time passes; an active lease ticks down toward expiry
Tick(b) ==
  /\ holder[b] # "none"
  /\ ttl[b] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = ttl[b] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, claim, crashed>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed, clearing both sides of the reservation (also frees crashed holders)
Expire(b) ==
  /\ holder[b] # "none"
  /\ ttl[b] = 0
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![holder[b]] = "none"]
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, crashed>>

\* A patron may crash silently; the system tolerates at most MaxCrash such failures
Crash(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < MaxCrash
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, claim, ttl>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Reserve(p, b) \/ Renew(p, b)
  \/ \E b \in Books : Tick(b) \/ Expire(b)
  \/ \E p \in Patrons : Crash(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The holder record and each patron's claim always agree in both directions, so a book is never
\* double-allocated -- reserved to two patrons at once.
Consistent ==
  /\ \A b \in Books : holder[b] # "none" => claim[holder[b]] = b
  /\ \A p \in Patrons : claim[p] # "none" => holder[claim[p]] = p

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Books = {bk1, bk2}
  Patrons = {u1, u2}
  MaxTTL = 2
  MaxCrash = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Consistent
nl: A library book-reservation system grants books to patrons under leases with expiry. A live patron reserves a currently free book, taking a lease and recording the reservation on both sides -- the book's holder field and the patron's own claim. A live patron may renew its lease to reset the time-to-live. As time passes an active lease ticks down, and once it reaches zero the lease expires and is reclaimed, clearing both sides of the reservation. The system tolerates silent crashes: at most one patron may crash without warning, after which it stops renewing, so its lease eventually expires and the book is reclaimed for others. SAFETY PROPERTY: the book-side holder record and each patron-side claim always agree in both directions, so no book is ever reserved to two patrons at the same time.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od3m0p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks, MaxSlot, MaxV
ASSUME MaxSlot \in Nat /\ MaxV \in Nat

VARIABLES slotOwner, version, seen, capacity, loc
\* slotOwner: [1..MaxSlot -> Banks \cup {"none"}] which bank owns each settlement slot
\* version: optimistic-lock version counter for the batch (wraps)
\* seen: [Banks -> 0..MaxV] the version each trying bank last observed
\* capacity: highest slot index open in the batch right now; changes at runtime
\* loc: [Banks -> {"idle","trying"}] control location of each bank
vars == <<slotOwner, version, seen, capacity, loc>>

Slots == 1..MaxSlot
Bump(v) == IF v = MaxV THEN 0 ELSE v + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> Banks \cup {"none"}]
  /\ version \in 0..MaxV
  /\ seen \in [Banks -> 0..MaxV]
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxSlot
  /\ loc \in [Banks -> {"idle","trying"}]

Init ==
  /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
  /\ version = 0
  /\ seen = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ capacity = MaxSlot
  /\ loc = [b \in Banks |-> "idle"]

\* A bank optimistically reads the batch version before attempting to claim a slot
Read(b) ==
  /\ loc[b] = "idle"
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![b] = version]
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![b] = "trying"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, version, capacity>>

\* Claim a free, in-capacity slot; succeeds only if the version is unchanged since the read
Claim(b, s) ==
  /\ loc[b] = "trying"
  /\ seen[b] = version
  /\ s <= capacity
  /\ slotOwner[s] = "none"
  /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = b]
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![b] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, capacity>>

\* A version mismatch means another bank intervened; re-read and retry
Retry(b) ==
  /\ loc[b] = "trying"
  /\ seen[b] # version
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![b] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, version, capacity, loc>>

\* A bank releases a slot it owns, bumping the version
Release(b, s) ==
  /\ slotOwner[s] = b
  /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, capacity, loc>>

\* The batch capacity is changed at runtime; it may never be shrunk below an owned slot
Reconfigure ==
  /\ \E c \in 0..MaxSlot :
        /\ \A s \in Slots : slotOwner[s] # "none" => s <= c
        /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, version, seen, loc>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Read(b) \/ Retry(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Slots : Claim(b, s) \/ Release(b, s)
  \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every owned settlement slot always lies within the batch's current capacity: a bank never
\* holds a slot that runtime reconfiguration has placed outside the open capacity band.
CapacityCoherent == \A s \in Slots : slotOwner[s] # "none" => s <= capacity

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Banks = {bkA, bkB}
  MaxSlot = 3
  MaxV = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityCoherent
nl: A bank's interbank settlement batch hands out numbered settlement slots using optimistic locking with retry. A bank first reads the batch's version counter, then attempts to claim a slot: the claim succeeds only if the version is unchanged since its read, the slot is free, and the slot index falls within the batch's current capacity; a successful claim bumps the version. If the version changed in the meantime, another bank intervened, so the bank re-reads and retries. A bank may release a slot it owns, again bumping the version. The batch capacity is changed at runtime, but it may never be shrunk below the index of any slot that is currently owned. Because each slot has a single owner field claimed only while free, no slot is ever allocated to two banks. SAFETY PROPERTY: every owned settlement slot always lies within the batch's current capacity band, so no bank ever holds a slot placed outside capacity by a runtime reconfiguration.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od9m5p2t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, TLC
CONSTANTS Operators, Quorum, MaxRound
ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ MaxRound \in Nat

VARIABLES load, proposal, votes, round
\* load: [Segments -> Nat] megawatts of load currently on each grid segment
\* proposal: the pending transfer <<from, to>> awaiting a quorum, or "none"
\* votes: operators that have voted for the current proposal
\* round: number of transfers committed so far (bounds the batch)
vars == <<load, proposal, votes, round>>

Segments == {"segA", "segB", "segC"}
Total == 3
SumLoad == load["segA"] + load["segB"] + load["segC"]

TypeOK ==
  /\ load \in [Segments -> 0..Total]
  /\ proposal \in (Segments \X Segments) \cup {"none"}
  /\ votes \subseteq Operators
  /\ round \in 0..MaxRound

Init ==
  /\ load = ("segA" :> 2 @@ "segB" :> 1 @@ "segC" :> 0)
  /\ proposal = "none"
  /\ votes = {}
  /\ round = 0

\* Propose transferring one unit of load from one segment to another
Propose(f, t) ==
  /\ proposal = "none"
  /\ f # t
  /\ proposal' = <<f, t>>
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, round>>

\* An operator (which may be slow, but never fails) casts a vote for the pending transfer
Vote(o) ==
  /\ proposal # "none"
  /\ o \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, proposal, round>>

\* With a quorum of votes and a non-empty source, commit the transfer: one unit moves, none is lost
Commit ==
  /\ proposal # "none"
  /\ round < MaxRound
  /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
  /\ load[proposal[1]] > 0
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![proposal[1]] = load[proposal[1]] - 1,
                         ![proposal[2]] = load[proposal[2]] + 1]
  /\ proposal' = "none"
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ round' = round + 1

\* A proposal that did not reach quorum in time is abandoned, and a fresh one may be proposed
Abort ==
  /\ proposal # "none"
  /\ proposal' = "none"
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, round>>

Next ==
  \/ \E f, t \in Segments : Propose(f, t)
  \/ \E o \in Operators : Vote(o)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The total load across all segments is conserved: load is only moved, never created or destroyed.
Conserved == SumLoad = Total

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Operators = {op1, op2, op3}
  Quorum = 2
  MaxRound = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl: A power-grid load shedder moves load between grid segments, and every transfer requires quorum approval by the control operators. A transfer of one unit from a source segment to a destination is first proposed; operators, who may be slow but never fail, each cast a vote for the pending proposal. Once a quorum of votes is reached and the source segment is non-empty, the transfer commits: exactly one unit leaves the source and the same unit arrives at the destination. A proposal that fails to gather a quorum in time is abandoned and a fresh one may be proposed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total load summed across all segments is always conserved -- load is only ever moved between segments, never created or destroyed.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od15m2p1t0 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Participants, MaxCrash
ASSUME MaxCrash \in Nat

VARIABLES decision, vote, pState, record, crashed
\* decision: coordinator's write-once decision: "none", "commit", or "abort"
\* vote: [Participants -> {"none","yes","no"}] each participant's prepare vote
\* pState: [Participants -> {"working","prepared","committed","aborted"}]
\* record: participants whose commit has been durably written to the shared trade record
\* crashed: participants that have silently crashed (at most MaxCrash)
vars == <<decision, vote, pState, record, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ decision \in {"none","commit","abort"}
  /\ vote \in [Participants -> {"none","yes","no"}]
  /\ pState \in [Participants -> {"working","prepared","committed","aborted"}]
  /\ record \subseteq Participants
  /\ crashed \subseteq Participants

Init ==
  /\ decision = "none"
  /\ vote = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ pState = [p \in Participants |-> "working"]
  /\ record = {}
  /\ crashed = {}

\* Phase 1: a live participant prepares and votes yes or no
Prepare(p, v) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ pState[p] = "working"
  /\ v \in {"yes","no"}
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = v]
  /\ pState' = [pState EXCEPT ![p] = "prepared"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, record, crashed>>

\* The coordinator decides commit only if every participant has prepared and voted yes
DecideCommit ==
  /\ decision = "none"
  /\ \A p \in Participants : vote[p] = "yes"
  /\ decision' = "commit"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, pState, record, crashed>>

\* The coordinator decides abort if any participant voted no or has crashed
DecideAbort ==
  /\ decision = "none"
  /\ \E p \in Participants : vote[p] = "no" \/ p \in crashed
  /\ decision' = "abort"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, pState, record, crashed>>

\* Phase 2 commit: a prepared participant applies the commit and durably logs it in one step
ApplyCommit(p) ==
  /\ decision = "commit"
  /\ pState[p] = "prepared"
  /\ pState' = [pState EXCEPT ![p] = "committed"]
  /\ record' = record \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, vote, crashed>>

\* Phase 2 abort: a prepared participant applies the abort
ApplyAbort(p) ==
  /\ decision = "abort"
  /\ pState[p] = "prepared"
  /\ pState' = [pState EXCEPT ![p] = "aborted"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, vote, record, crashed>>

\* A participant may crash silently; the auction tolerates at most MaxCrash such failures
Crash(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < MaxCrash
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, vote, pState, record>>

\* Once the round has settled, the coordinator opens a fresh auction (the durable record persists)
Reset ==
  /\ decision # "none"
  /\ \A p \in Participants : pState[p] \in {"committed","aborted"} \/ p \in crashed
  /\ decision' = "none"
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ pState' = [p \in Participants |-> "working"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, crashed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Participants, v \in {"yes","no"} : Prepare(p, v)
  \/ DecideCommit \/ DecideAbort \/ Reset
  \/ \E p \in Participants : ApplyCommit(p) \/ ApplyAbort(p) \/ Crash(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any participant that has committed is durably present in the shared trade record: no commit is lost.
NoLostCommit == \A p \in Participants : pState[p] = "committed" => p \in record

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Participants = {pt1, pt2}
  MaxCrash = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostCommit
nl: A stock exchange runs its opening auction as a two-phase commit across the participating firms. In phase one, each live participant prepares and votes yes or no. The coordinator then makes a single, permanent decision: it decides commit only if every participant has prepared and voted yes, and decides abort if any participant voted no or has crashed. In phase two, each prepared participant applies the coordinator's decision: on commit it moves to committed and, in the same step, durably logs its commit in the shared trade record; on abort it moves to aborted. The auction tolerates one participant crashing silently, after which it takes no further steps. Once every participant has either applied the decision or crashed, the coordinator opens a fresh auction while the durable trade record persists. SAFETY PROPERTY: any participant that has committed is always durably present in the shared trade record, so no commit is ever lost.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m5p5t2 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Rx, Approvers, Instances, Quorum
ASSUME Quorum \in Nat

VARIABLES active, votes, dispensed, dispensedBy, snapVotes
\* active: prescriptions currently open for approval voting
\* votes: [Rx -> SUBSET Approvers] approvers that have voted for each prescription
\* dispensed: prescriptions already irreversibly dispensed (write-once membership)
\* dispensedBy: [Rx -> Instances \cup {"none"}] which dispenser instance dispensed it
\* snapVotes: [Rx -> 0..Card(Approvers)] vote count captured at the moment of dispensing
vars == <<active, votes, dispensed, dispensedBy, snapVotes>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ active \subseteq Rx
  /\ votes \in [Rx -> SUBSET Approvers]
  /\ dispensed \subseteq Rx
  /\ dispensedBy \in [Rx -> Instances \cup {"none"}]
  /\ snapVotes \in [Rx -> 0..Cardinality(Approvers)]

Init ==
  /\ active = {}
  /\ votes = [r \in Rx |-> {}]
  /\ dispensed = {}
  /\ dispensedBy = [r \in Rx |-> "none"]
  /\ snapVotes = [r \in Rx |-> 0]

\* Open a prescription for approval voting
Open(r) ==
  /\ r \notin active
  /\ active' = active \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, dispensed, dispensedBy, snapVotes>>

\* An approver casts a vote for an open prescription
Vote(a, r) ==
  /\ r \in active
  /\ a \notin votes[r]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = votes[r] \cup {a}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<active, dispensed, dispensedBy, snapVotes>>

\* Either dispenser instance dispenses a not-yet-dispensed prescription that has a quorum,
\* capturing the approving vote count; both instances draw from the same shared prescription pool
Dispense(i, r) ==
  /\ r \in active
  /\ r \notin dispensed
  /\ Cardinality(votes[r]) >= Quorum
  /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {r}
  /\ dispensedBy' = [dispensedBy EXCEPT ![r] = i]
  /\ snapVotes' = [snapVotes EXCEPT ![r] = Cardinality(votes[r])]
  /\ active' = active \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

\* A prescription may be retired from the active pool, resetting its collected votes
Retire(r) ==
  /\ r \in active
  /\ active' = active \ {r}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dispensed, dispensedBy, snapVotes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Rx : Open(r) \/ Retire(r)
  \/ \E a \in Approvers, r \in Rx : Vote(a, r)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Rx : Dispense(i, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every irreversibly dispensed prescription was dispensed only after a quorum of approvers
\* voted for it; combined with the write-once dispensed set, each is dispensed at most once.
DispenseAuthorized == \A r \in Rx : r \in dispensed => snapVotes[r] >= Quorum

=============================================================================
nl: A pharmacy prescription dispenser requires quorum approval before any prescription is dispensed, and two independent dispenser instances draw from the same shared prescription pool. A prescription is opened for approval voting, and each approver may cast a single vote for it. Either instance may dispense a not-yet-dispensed prescription only once it has collected a quorum of approving votes; dispensing is the irreversible action, and it captures the approving vote count at that moment and records which instance dispensed it. A prescription may instead be retired from the active pool, which clears its collected votes, and it can later be reopened. SAFETY PROPERTY: every irreversibly dispensed prescription was dispensed only after a quorum of approvers voted for it, and since the dispensed set is write-once each prescription is dispensed at most once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m9p6t5 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, mEpoch, acting, authorized, admin
\* epoch: current network configuration epoch
\* mEpoch: [Machines -> 0..MaxEpoch] the epoch each machine is synced to
\* acting: [Machines -> BOOLEAN] whether a machine is currently performing a dispense
\* authorized: [Machines -> BOOLEAN] admin-granted override permission per machine
\* admin: TRUE while the privileged admin override console is unlocked
vars == <<epoch, mEpoch, acting, authorized, admin>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ mEpoch \in [Machines -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ acting \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ authorized \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ mEpoch = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ acting = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
  /\ authorized = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
  /\ admin = FALSE

\* Reconfigure to a new epoch; a machine that is mid-action may be stranded stale only if it
\* holds an admin override, so any still-acting machine must be authorized first
Reconfigure ==
  /\ \A m \in Machines : acting[m] => authorized[m]
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch = MaxEpoch THEN 0 ELSE epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<mEpoch, acting, authorized, admin>>

\* A machine syncs to the current epoch, becoming fresh/authorized to act
Sync(m) ==
  /\ mEpoch[m] # epoch
  /\ mEpoch' = [mEpoch EXCEPT ![m] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, acting, authorized, admin>>

\* A machine begins a dispense only if it is fresh (current epoch) or holds an admin override
Act(m) ==
  /\ ~acting[m]
  /\ (mEpoch[m] = epoch \/ authorized[m])
  /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mEpoch, authorized, admin>>

\* A machine finishes its dispense
Finish(m) ==
  /\ acting[m]
  /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mEpoch, authorized, admin>>

\* The privileged admin override grants or revokes a machine's override permission
AdminGrant(m, b) ==
  /\ admin
  /\ (b \/ ~acting[m] \/ mEpoch[m] = epoch)
  /\ authorized' = [authorized EXCEPT ![m] = b]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mEpoch, acting, admin>>

\* Toggle the admin override console
AdminToggle ==
  /\ admin' = ~admin
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mEpoch, acting, authorized>>

Next ==
  \/ Reconfigure \/ AdminToggle
  \/ \E m \in Machines : Sync(m) \/ Act(m) \/ Finish(m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines, b \in BOOLEAN : AdminGrant(m, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No machine ever performs an action while stale (out of sync with the current epoch) unless it
\* has been granted an admin override: no action by an unauthorized or stale participant.
NoStaleAction == \A m \in Machines : acting[m] => (mEpoch[m] = epoch \/ authorized[m])

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Machines = {m1, m2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAction
nl: A network of vending machines is reconfigured by epoch number, wrapping through a bounded range. Each machine tracks the epoch it is synced to, and a machine may begin a dispense only if it is fresh -- synced to the current epoch -- or holds an admin override. A machine syncs to the current epoch to become fresh, begins a dispense when eligible, and later finishes it. Reconfiguration to a new epoch is only permitted when every machine that is currently mid-dispense holds an admin override, so no ordinary machine is left stranded acting while stale. Separately, a privileged admin override console can be unlocked and, while unlocked, may grant a machine an override, or revoke it only when that machine is not currently relying on it (not acting while stale). SAFETY PROPERTY: no machine ever performs a dispense while stale -- out of sync with the current epoch -- unless it has been granted an admin override, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever acts.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od18m0p6t0 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Devices, MaxV, MaxCrash
ASSUME MaxV \in Nat /\ MaxCrash \in Nat

VARIABLES version, seen, applying, lockState, crashed
\* version: version stamp of the shared lock register (wraps)
\* seen: [Devices -> 0..MaxV] the version each device last read
\* applying: [Devices -> BOOLEAN] whether a device is in its optimistic apply section
\* lockState: the shared door state, TRUE = locked
\* crashed: devices that have silently crashed (at most MaxCrash)
vars == <<version, seen, applying, lockState, crashed>>

Bump(v) == IF v = MaxV THEN 0 ELSE v + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0..MaxV
  /\ seen \in [Devices -> 0..MaxV]
  /\ applying \in [Devices -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ lockState \in BOOLEAN
  /\ crashed \subseteq Devices

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ seen = [d \in Devices |-> 0]
  /\ applying = [d \in Devices |-> FALSE]
  /\ lockState = FALSE
  /\ crashed = {}

\* A live device optimistically reads the current version stamp
Read(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ ~applying[d]
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![d] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applying, lockState, crashed>>

\* A live device enters its apply section only if its read is current and no other device is applying
Begin(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ ~applying[d]
  /\ seen[d] = version
  /\ \A e \in Devices : ~applying[e]
  /\ applying' = [applying EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, seen, lockState, crashed>>

\* The applying device commits its lock/unlock, bumping the version stamp
Commit(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ applying[d]
  /\ lockState' = ~lockState
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ applying' = [applying EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, crashed>>

\* A device may crash silently; crashing abandons any in-flight apply, releasing the soft lock
Crash(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < MaxCrash
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
  /\ applying' = [applying EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, seen, lockState>>

Next == \E d \in Devices : Read(d) \/ Begin(d) \/ Commit(d) \/ Crash(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any device inside its apply section is working from the current version stamp: a stale device
\* never sits in the apply section, so no stale (or crashed-and-abandoned) participant applies.
NoStaleApply == \A d \in Devices : applying[d] => seen[d] = version

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Devices = {dv1, dv2, dv3}
  MaxV = 2
  MaxCrash = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleApply
nl: A smart-home door-lock network coordinates lock and unlock commands with optimistic locking and retry over a shared version stamp. A live device first reads the current version stamp. It may enter its apply section only if its read is still current and no other device is presently applying. The applying device then commits its lock or unlock, flipping the shared door state and bumping the version stamp. The network tolerates one device crashing silently; a crash abandons any in-flight apply, releasing the soft lock so other devices can proceed. A device whose read has gone stale simply reads again and retries. SAFETY PROPERTY: any device inside its apply section is always working from the current version stamp, so no stale or crashed-and-abandoned participant ever applies a command.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od15m3p0t0 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm, MaxCrash
ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxCrash \in Nat

VARIABLES leader, term, inCS, crashed
\* leader: the currently elected leader node, or "none"
\* term: monotone election term number
\* inCS: [Nodes -> BOOLEAN] whether a node is inside the critical match-engine section
\* crashed: nodes that have silently crashed (at most MaxCrash)
vars == <<leader, term, inCS, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {"none"}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ inCS \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
  /\ leader = "none"
  /\ term = 0
  /\ inCS = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
  /\ crashed = {}

\* Elect a live node as leader when there is no leader or the current leader has crashed (failover)
Elect(n) ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ (leader = "none" \/ leader \in crashed)
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, crashed>>

\* Only the live leader may enter the critical match-engine section
Enter(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ ~inCS[n]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

\* The leader leaves the critical section
Exit(n) ==
  /\ inCS[n]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

\* A node may crash silently; crashing vacates the critical section it may have held
Crash(n) ==
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < MaxCrash
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Next == \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n) \/ Enter(n) \/ Exit(n) \/ Crash(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Only the current leader is ever inside the critical section; since there is a single leader,
\* at most one node uses the critical match engine at a time -- mutual exclusion.
MutexCS == \A n \in Nodes : inCS[n] => leader = n

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {nd1, nd2, nd3}
  MaxTerm = 3
  MaxCrash = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexCS
nl: A stock exchange opening auction runs its match engine as a critical resource guarded by leader election with failover. A live node is elected leader whenever there is currently no leader or the sitting leader has crashed; each election advances the term. Only the live leader may enter the critical match-engine section, and it later exits. The auction tolerates one node crashing silently; a crash immediately vacates any critical section that node was holding, and because the crashed leader is then eligible for replacement, a fresh leader can fail over and take control. SAFETY PROPERTY: only the current leader is ever inside the critical section, and since there is a single leader at a time, at most one node uses the critical match engine at once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m0p5t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Matches, Players, MaxV
ASSUME MaxV \in Nat

VARIABLES matchState, finalizedBy, version, seen, loc
\* matchState: [Matches -> {"open","finalized"}] lifecycle of each match
\* finalizedBy: [Matches -> Players \cup {"none"}] which player finalized the match
\* version: optimistic-lock version counter for the matchmaker (wraps)
\* seen: [Players -> 0..MaxV] the version each trying player last read
\* loc: [Players -> {"idle","trying"}] control location of each player
vars == <<matchState, finalizedBy, version, seen, loc>>

Bump(v) == IF v = MaxV THEN 0 ELSE v + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ matchState \in [Matches -> {"open","finalized"}]
  /\ finalizedBy \in [Matches -> Players \cup {"none"}]
  /\ version \in 0..MaxV
  /\ seen \in [Players -> 0..MaxV]
  /\ loc \in [Players -> {"idle","trying"}]

Init ==
  /\ matchState = [m \in Matches |-> "open"]
  /\ finalizedBy = [m \in Matches |-> "none"]
  /\ version = 0
  /\ seen = [p \in Players |-> 0]
  /\ loc = [p \in Players |-> "idle"]

\* A player optimistically reads the matchmaker version before attempting to finalize
Read(p) ==
  /\ loc[p] = "idle"
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![p] = version]
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![p] = "trying"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<matchState, finalizedBy, version>>

\* Finalize a match (the irreversible action); succeeds only if the version is unchanged since
\* the read and the match is still open, recording the finalizer and bumping the version
Finalize(p, m) ==
  /\ loc[p] = "trying"
  /\ seen[p] = version
  /\ matchState[m] = "open"
  /\ matchState' = [matchState EXCEPT ![m] = "finalized"]
  /\ finalizedBy' = [finalizedBy EXCEPT ![m] = p]
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED seen

\* A version mismatch means another player intervened; re-read and retry
Retry(p) ==
  /\ loc[p] = "trying"
  /\ seen[p] # version
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![p] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<matchState, finalizedBy, version, loc>>

\* A slow player may yield without finalizing and try again later; it is slow but never fails
Yield(p) ==
  /\ loc[p] = "trying"
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<matchState, finalizedBy, version, seen>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Players : Read(p) \/ Retry(p) \/ Yield(p)
  \/ \E p \in Players, m \in Matches : Finalize(p, m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A match is recorded as finalized exactly when it has a recorded finalizer, and never reverts:
\* the irreversible finalize of any match happens at most once and is consistently recorded.
FinalizeConsistent ==
  \A m \in Matches : (matchState[m] = "finalized") <=> (finalizedBy[m] # "none")

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Matches = {g1, g2}
  Players = {p1, p2}
  MaxV = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FinalizeConsistent
nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker finalizes matches using optimistic locking with retry. A player first reads the matchmaker's version counter, then attempts to finalize a match. Finalizing a match is the irreversible action: it succeeds only if the version is unchanged since the player's read and the match is still open, at which point the match becomes finalized, the finalizing player is recorded, and the version is bumped. If the version changed in the meantime, another player intervened, so the player re-reads and retries. A player may be slow -- yielding without finalizing and trying again later -- but never fails. SAFETY PROPERTY: a match is recorded as finalized exactly when it has a recorded finalizer and never reverts, so the irreversible finalize of any match happens at most once and is consistently recorded.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m6p4t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Robots, Stations, Cap, MaxTTL
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ MaxTTL \in Nat

VARIABLES occ, station, ttl, admin
\* occ: [Stations -> 0..Card(Robots)] number of active charging leases at each station
\* station: [Robots -> Stations \cup {"none"}] which station a robot currently leases a dock at
\* ttl: [Robots -> 0..MaxTTL] remaining lease time for a robot's dock
\* admin: TRUE while the privileged admin override is unlocked
vars == <<occ, station, ttl, admin>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ occ \in [Stations -> 0..Cardinality(Robots)]
  /\ station \in [Robots -> Stations \cup {"none"}]
  /\ ttl \in [Robots -> 0..MaxTTL]
  /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ occ = [s \in Stations |-> 0]
  /\ station = [r \in Robots |-> "none"]
  /\ ttl = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ admin = FALSE

\* Grant a charging-dock lease to an idle robot, but only if the station is below its capacity
Grant(r, s) ==
  /\ station[r] = "none"
  /\ occ[s] < Cap
  /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![r] = s]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![r] = MaxTTL]
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![s] = occ[s] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED admin

\* Renew a robot's active lease, resetting its time-to-live
Renew(r) ==
  /\ station[r] # "none"
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![r] = MaxTTL]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, station, admin>>

\* Time passes; an active lease ticks down toward expiry
Tick(r) ==
  /\ station[r] # "none"
  /\ ttl[r] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![r] = ttl[r] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, station, admin>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the robot's dock and a capacity unit at its station
Expire(r) ==
  /\ station[r] # "none"
  /\ ttl[r] = 0
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![station[r]] = occ[station[r]] - 1]
  /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![r] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, admin>>

\* The privileged admin override force-reclaims a robot's lease regardless of its time-to-live
AdminReclaim(r) ==
  /\ admin
  /\ station[r] # "none"
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![station[r]] = occ[station[r]] - 1]
  /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![r] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, admin>>

\* Toggle the admin override lock
AdminToggle ==
  /\ admin' = ~admin
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, station, ttl>>

Next ==
  \/ AdminToggle
  \/ \E r \in Robots, s \in Stations : Grant(r, s)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Renew(r) \/ Tick(r) \/ Expire(r) \/ AdminReclaim(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No charging station ever holds more active dock leases than its capacity.
CapacityOK == \A s \in Stations : occ[s] <= Cap
